component.name: Markdown Editor
component.summary: Write Markdown with a live preview

description.p: Markdown Editor is a Markdown editor and viewer modelled on GNOME Text Editor. The preview sits next to the text, scrolls with it and renders what technical documents use: Mermaid diagrams, math, GitHub alerts and Marp slide decks.

ul.li: Mermaid diagrams of every type, KaTeX math and syntax highlighting for all common languages
Marp slide decks: a document with “marp: true” previews as slides, with themes and directives
GitHub and Hugo conventions: alerts, task lists, footnotes, front matter, heading anchors and links between documents
Large documents stay responsive: only the edited section is rendered again
Changelog sections fold away until needed
Tabs, find and replace, a heading outline, spell checking and formatting shortcuts
Synchronized scrolling, printing and HTML export

screenshot.caption: The editor with the live preview

description.p: Marp slide decks, and a new application ID.

ul.li: Documents with “marp: true” in their front matter preview as Marp slides, with highlighting for directives and slide separators.

The application ID is now io.github._24icewolf42.markdown-editor and the command is markdown-editor. Settings from earlier versions carry over, except in the Flatpak; uninstall the old Flatpak (io.github.gnome_markdown_editor) separately.
The Flatpak only has access to the home folder instead of the whole file system.
Flatpak bundle: self-contained on the GNOME 51 runtime, with spell checking.
AppImage: small; runs on GNOME 49 or newer desktops using the system libraries.
Spell checking is optional when libspelling is not installed.

description.p: Large documents edit and scroll smoothly; changelog sections are folded by default.
